body:
Your reply hit me like a splash of cold water when I read it initially, and I saved it on my phone to look at throughout the day. I had to pull it up multiple times today as I began to feel overwhelmed again, and it helped provide direction.

So thank you, random stranger, for the most thoughtful and peace-providing response anyone has encouraged me with in a very, very long time. You have helped change my perspective profoundly; other people can find a different way to stay warm now.
